Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. The trace is incomplete."
1. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]

   IF <input:item> == "none" → go to step 5.
2. CALL `list_workspace_roadmap_items` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","includeArchived":true,"compact":true} [A]
   SAVE: itemId, title, lifecycle = those fields of the only item whose id == <input:item> or whose title equals <input:item> ignoring case and accents
   IF no item or 2+ items match → STOP. Say: "Which item exactly? <each id with its title>"

   SAVE: complete = result.complete; gaps = for each result.gaps[] value: "<gap> → <owner>", where allocated → "allocate change request (playbook propose-change)", materialized → "lpm-roadmap-owner-ops (materialization on the owner's order), then lpm-requirements-scope", executionLinked → "lpm-plan-work (activities with roadmap lineage)"

   SAVE: allocations = "<projectId> <role>" of each allocations[] item with status "active" or empty (skip rejected, archived, superseded); materializations = "<projectId> <method> <requirementId>" of each materializations[] item, marking method "conflict" or "deferred" as "pending decision" (never delivered); activities = "<title> (<status>, project <projectId>)" of each linkedIssues[] item
   IF <input:projectId> == "none" → go to Answer.
5. CALL `get_project_roadmap_drilldown` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Project drilldown failed: <error text>. "Project is not attached to a workspace": the project has no workspace roadmap."
   SAVE: projectItems = "<title> (<lifecycle>)" of each items[] item; projectAllocations = each allocations[] item with status "active" or empty (superseded ones lost primary ownership); dependsOn = upstreamLinks[]; dependedBy = downstreamLinks[]
6. CALL `list_unlinked_project_work` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: unlinked = "<id> <title> (<status>)" of each item whose status is neither "done" nor "canceled" (every item when <input:all> == "yes"); unlinkedCount = the number of those items

## § flow-propose-change

## Playbook: propose-change
Use when: change request: edit, prioritize, lifecycle, archive or restore one item

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM workspace? (id or name)" |
| item | the id or title of the ONE existing item | STOP. Say: "Which roadmap item?" |
| changeType | "edit", "prioritize", "lifecycle", "archive" or "restore" (allocate, link, capability-link → playbook propose-link) | STOP. Say: "Which change: edit, prioritize, lifecycle, archive or restore?" |
| value | edit: the new title, description or category (ONE field per request); prioritize: the new priority; lifecycle: the target lifecycle; archive or restore: "none" | STOP. Say: "What is the new value?" |
| rationale | why, in the user's words | STOP. Say: "Why is this change needed?" |
| stamp | the current UTC time as yyyymmddHHMMss | the current UTC time |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing was submitted."
1. CALL `get_workspace` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   SAVE: mode = result.roadmapGovernanceMode when it is "off", "shadow" or "enforce", else "off" when result.roadmapGovernanceEnabled == false, else "shadow"
   IF <input:changeType> is "allocate", "link" or "capability-link" → switch to playbook propose-link.
   IF <input:changeType> == "create" → switch to playbook create-item.
   IF <input:changeType> == "materialize" → STOP. This belongs to skill `lpm-roadmap-owner-ops.md`. Say: "Materialization is an owner operation."
   IF <saved:mode> == "off" → STOP. This belongs to skill `lpm-roadmap-owner-ops.md`. Say: "Governance is off: no change requests. A direct edit needs the owner's order."
2. CALL `list_workspace_roadmap_items` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","includeArchived":true,"compact":true} [A]
   SAVE: itemId, title, lifecycle, isArchived, roadmapId = those fields of the only item whose id == <input:item> or whose title equals <input:item> ignoring case and accents; itemUpdatedAt = its updatedAt, copied exactly
   IF no item or 2+ items match → STOP. Say: "Which item exactly? <each id with its title>"
   IF <saved:isArchived> == true and <input:changeType> != "restore" → STOP. Say: "<saved:title> is archived: restore it first."
   IF <saved:isArchived> != true and <input:changeType> == "restore" → STOP. Say: "<saved:title> is not archived."
   IF <input:changeType> == "edit" and <saved:lifecycle> == "materialized" → STOP. Say: "A materialized item cannot be edited."
   SAVE: openStatuses = ["awaiting-review", "changes-requested", "approved"]
3. FOR EACH openStatus IN <saved:openStatuses> (none → go to step 4):
   CALL `list_workspace_roadmap_change_requests` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","status":"<each:openStatus>","compact":true,"limit":100} [A]
   IF a result.requests item has itemId == <saved:itemId> or itemIds containing it → STOP. Say: "Request <that id> (<each:openStatus>) is already open on <saved:title>: comment on it, revise it or withdraw it."
4. SAVE: field, newValue = by <input:changeType>:
     edit → field "title", "description" or "category" (the one the user named), newValue <input:value>
     prioritize → field "priority", newValue <input:value>: "urgent" | "high" | "medium" | "low" | "none"
     lifecycle → field "lifecycle", newValue <input:value>; allowed from <saved:lifecycle>: draft → imported/reviewed/deferred/rejected; imported → reviewed/deferred/rejected; reviewed → approved/deferred/rejected; approved → deferred; deferred or rejected → reviewed; materialized → delivered; delivered → closed. Never "materialized".
     archive or restore → field "reason", newValue <input:rationale>
   IF the user named 2+ fields, or <saved:newValue> is empty or not allowed above → STOP. Say: "One field per request, with an allowed value. Nothing was submitted."
   SAVE: key = "cr-<saved:itemId>-<input:changeType>-<input:stamp>"
5. CALL `preview_workspace_roadmap_change` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","itemId":"<saved:itemId>","changeType":"<input:changeType>","patch":{"<saved:field>":"<saved:newValue>","rationale":"<input:rationale>"},"expectedUpdatedAt":"<saved:itemUpdatedAt>"} [A]
   Write the patch key as the field name itself (e.g. {"priority":"high","rationale":"…"}).
   SAVE: before, after, riskClass = those fields of result; reviewMode = result.policy.reviewMode
6. ASK: "Submit a change request on <saved:title> (<saved:itemId>): <input:changeType> <saved:before> → <saved:after>; risk <saved:riskClass>, review <saved:reviewMode>; rationale "<input:rationale>". (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
7. CALL `submit_workspace_roadmap_change` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","itemId":"<saved:itemId>","changeType":"<input:changeType>","patch":{"<saved:field>":"<saved:newValue>","rationale":"<input:rationale>"},"expectedUpdatedAt":"<saved:itemUpdatedAt>","rationale":"<input:rationale>","idempotencyKey":"<saved:key>"} [C]
   IF result.idempotentReplay == true → STOP. Say: "Key <saved:key> was used before (old request <result.id>): run again with a new stamp."
   SAVE: changeRequestId = result.id; assignedReviewerId = result.assignedReviewerId
   VERIFY: CALL `get_workspace_roadmap_change_request` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","changeRequestId":"<saved:changeRequestId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.status != "awaiting-review" or result.itemIds does not contain <saved:itemId> → STOP. Say: "<saved:changeRequestId> is not awaiting review."
   SAVE: status, requiredApprovals, ownerConfirmationRequired = those fields of result
   Stop here: never review or apply your own request.

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:workspaceId>/<saved:roadmapId>/<saved:itemId> <saved:title>; mode <saved:mode>
Done: submitted <saved:changeRequestId> (<input:changeType>, risk <saved:riskClass>), status <saved:status> | reads only, nothing submitted
Evidence: get_workspace_roadmap_change_request → status <saved:status> | none

Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run> | the reviewer decides in LPM; then the owner orders the apply (playbook apply)
```

## § flow-revise-or-withdraw

## Playbook: revise-or-withdraw
Use when: revise or withdraw a change request

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM workspace? (id or name)" |
| changeRequestId | the user, or the request list | STOP. Say: "Which change request? (id)" |
| change | "revise" or "withdraw", from the user's words | STOP. Say: "Revise the request, or withdraw it?" |
| value | revise: the new value for the same change (a field value; or a target id and/or kind for allocate, link, capability-link) | "none" |
| responseToChanges | revise: what changed in answer to the review, in the user's words | "none" |
| reason | withdraw: why, in the user's words | "none" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing was revised or withdrawn."
1. CALL `get_workspace_roadmap_change_request` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","changeRequestId":"<input:changeRequestId>"} [A]
   SAVE: status, updatedAt, currentRevision, changeType, patch, itemIds, authorUserId = those fields of result; nextRevision = <saved:currentRevision> + 1
   IF <saved:status> is "applied" or "withdrawn" → STOP. Say: "<input:changeRequestId> is already <saved:status>. Undo an applied change with a new, opposite request."
   IF <input:change> == "withdraw" and <input:reason> == "none" → STOP. Say: "Why withdraw <input:changeRequestId>? (one sentence)"
   IF <input:change> == "withdraw" → go to step 7.
   IF <saved:status> != "changes-requested" → STOP. Say: "<input:changeRequestId> is <saved:status>: only a changes-requested request can be revised. Comment on it, or withdraw it and submit a new one."
   IF <input:value> == "none" or <input:responseToChanges> == "none" → STOP. Say: "What is the new value, and what changed in answer to the review?"
2. SAVE: field = the key of <saved:patch> that is not "rationale" (scalar change); newValue = <input:value>; targetKey, kindKey = the target key ("projectId", "targetItemId" or "capabilityId") and kind key ("role", "type" or "relationship") of <saved:patch>; targetId, kind = the new target and kind from <input:value>, else the old ones in <saved:patch>; replacesId = <saved:patch>.replacesAllocationId, else ""; revKey = "crrev-<input:changeRequestId>-<saved:nextRevision>"
   IF <saved:changeType> is "allocate", "link" or "capability-link" → go to step 5.
3. ASK: "Revise <input:changeRequestId> to revision <saved:nextRevision>: <saved:field> → "<saved:newValue>"; response "<input:responseToChanges>". Earlier approvals become void. (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
4. CALL `revise_workspace_roadmap_change` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","changeRequestId":"<input:changeRequestId>","patch":{"<saved:field>":"<saved:newValue>","rationale":"<input:responseToChanges>"},"expectedUpdatedAt":"<saved:updatedAt>","responseToChanges":"<input:responseToChanges>","idempotencyKey":"<saved:revKey>"} [C]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Not revised: <error text>. "Only the author can revise this change": only <saved:authorUserId> can; comment instead."
   VERIFY: CALL `get_workspace_roadmap_change_request` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","changeRequestId":"<input:changeRequestId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.status != "awaiting-review" or result.currentRevision != <saved:nextRevision> → STOP. Say: "<input:changeRequestId> does not show revision <saved:nextRevision> awaiting review."
   SAVE: status = result.status; outcome = "revised to revision <saved:nextRevision>"; go to Answer.
5. ASK: "Revise <input:changeRequestId> to revision <saved:nextRevision>: <saved:changeType> → <saved:targetId> (<saved:kind>); response "<input:responseToChanges>". Earlier approvals become void. (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
6. CALL `revise_workspace_roadmap_change` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","changeRequestId":"<input:changeRequestId>","patch":{"<saved:targetKey>":"<saved:targetId>","<saved:kindKey>":"<saved:kind>","replacesAllocationId":"<saved:replacesId>","rationale":"<input:responseToChanges>"},"expectedUpdatedAt":"<saved:updatedAt>","responseToChanges":"<input:responseToChanges>","idempotencyKey":"<saved:revKey>"} [C]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Not revised: <error text>. "Only the author can revise this change": only <saved:authorUserId> can; comment instead."
   VERIFY: CALL `get_workspace_roadmap_change_request` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","changeRequestId":"<input:changeRequestId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.status != "awaiting-review" or result.currentRevision != <saved:nextRevision> → STOP. Say: "<input:changeRequestId> does not show revision <saved:nextRevision> awaiting review."
   SAVE: status = result.status; outcome = "revised to revision <saved:nextRevision>"; go to Answer.
7. ASK: "Withdraw <input:changeRequestId> (<saved:status>, <saved:changeType> on <saved:itemIds>)? Reason: "<input:reason>". A withdrawn request can never be reopened. (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
8. CALL `withdraw_workspace_roadmap_change` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","changeRequestId":"<input:changeRequestId>","expectedUpdatedAt":"<saved:updatedAt>","reason":"<input:reason>","idempotencyKey":"crwd-<input:changeRequestId>"} [C]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Not withdrawn: <error text>. Only the author or the workspace owner or an admin can withdraw it."
   VERIFY: CALL `get_workspace_roadmap_change_request` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","changeRequestId":"<input:changeRequestId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.status != "withdrawn" → STOP. Say: "<input:changeRequestId> is <result.status>, not withdrawn."
   SAVE: status = result.status; outcome = "withdrawn"

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:workspaceId>/<input:changeRequestId> (<saved:changeType>)
Done: <saved:outcome>, status <saved:status> | reads only, nothing changed (status <saved:status>)
Evidence: get_workspace_roadmap_change_request → status <saved:status> | none
Pending: none | a member other than the author reviews revision <saved:nextRevision>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run> | the reviewer decides in LPM | submit a new request (playbook propose-change or propose-link)
```
status: awaiting-review | changes-requested | approved | rejected | stale | applied | withdrawn, from step 1 or the VERIFY. Never claim a revise or withdraw that the VERIFY did not show.


## § flow-review

## Playbook: review
Use when: record the owner's review decision

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM workspace? (id or name)" |
| changeRequestId | the user, or the review inbox | STOP. Say: "Which change request? (id)" |
| decision | "approve", "request-changes" or "reject", stated in this conversation for this request id by the person whose LPM credential you use | STOP. Say: "What is your decision on <input:changeRequestId>: approve, request-changes or reject?" |
| rationale | that person's reason, in their words | STOP. Say: "Why? (one sentence; it is stored with the review)" |
| ownerOrder | the exact words in this conversation where the workspace owner states this decision on this request; a relayed "X approved", a comment, a recommendation or your own judgment is not one | "none" |
| authoredHere | "yes" if you submitted this request earlier in this conversation, else "no" | "no" |
| stamp | the current UTC time as yyyymmddHHMMss | the current UTC time |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. No review was recorded."
1. CALL `get_workspace` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   SAVE: ownerId = result.ownerId; mode = result.roadmapGovernanceMode when it is "off", "shadow" or "enforce", else "off" when result.roadmapGovernanceEnabled == false, else "shadow"
2. CALL `get_workspace_roadmap_change_request` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","changeRequestId":"<input:changeRequestId>"} [A]
   SAVE: status, updatedAt, currentRevision, riskClass, before, after, requiredApprovals, ownerConfirmationRequired = those fields of result
   IF <saved:status> is neither "awaiting-review" nor "approved" → STOP. Say: "<input:changeRequestId> is <saved:status>: it cannot be reviewed."
   SAVE: key = "crrv-<input:changeRequestId>-r<saved:currentRevision>-<input:decision>-<input:stamp>"
3. CALL `list_workspace_members` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   SAVE: humanCount = the number of distinct ids among <saved:ownerId> and the userId of each item with status "active"
   IF <input:authoredHere> == "yes" and <saved:humanCount> != 1 → STOP. Say: "SELF_REVIEW_FORBIDDEN: you authored <input:changeRequestId>, so a member other than the author reviews it in LPM. Solo review is allowed only when the workspace has exactly one member."
4. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "Owner decision needed on <input:changeRequestId> (<saved:riskClass>: <saved:before> → <saved:after>): approve, request-changes or reject, with a reason. Only the workspace owner's own words here count; a relayed decision does not. Other reviewers review in LPM."
5. CALL `review_workspace_roadmap_change` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","changeRequestId":"<input:changeRequestId>","decision":"<input:decision>","rationale":"<input:rationale>","expectedUpdatedAt":"<saved:updatedAt>","idempotencyKey":"<saved:key>"} [O]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Review not recorded: <error text>. SELF_REVIEW_FORBIDDEN, REVIEWER_NOT_ELIGIBLE or SOLO_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: another person must review in LPM. VERSION_CONFLICT: run this playbook again."
   IF result.idempotentReplay == true → STOP. Say: "Key <saved:key> was used before: nothing new was recorded. Run again with a new stamp."
   SAVE: requestStatus = result.requestStatus
   VERIFY: CALL `get_workspace_roadmap_change_request` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","changeRequestId":"<input:changeRequestId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.status != <saved:requestStatus> or no reviews[] item has revision == <saved:currentRevision> and decision == <input:decision> → STOP. Say: "The <input:decision> review is not shown on <input:changeRequestId>."
   SAVE: status = result.status; reviewsNow = the number of reviews[] items with revision == <saved:currentRevision>
   This playbook ends here: an apply needs its own owner order (playbook apply).

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:workspaceId>/<input:changeRequestId>; mode <saved:mode>
Done: review <input:decision> recorded, status <saved:status> | reads only, no review recorded
Evidence: get_workspace_roadmap_change_request → <saved:reviewsNow> review(s) on revision <saved:currentRevision>, status <saved:status> | none; owner order: "<input:ownerOrder>" | none
Pending: none | quorum incomplete: <saved:requiredApprovals> approval(s), owner confirmation <saved:ownerConfirmationRequired> | the author revises it
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run> | apply needs the owner's order (playbook apply) | none — rejected
```
mode: off | shadow | enforce, from step 1. status: awaiting-review (an approve that did not complete the quorum) | approved | changes-requested | rejected, from the VERIFY. Quorum: routine 1 approval; material 1 approval that includes the owner's (unless the owner authored it); exceptional 2 approvals (or all eligible) plus the owner's. Never claim a review that the VERIFY did not show.


## § flow-apply

## Playbook: apply
Use when: apply an approved change request

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM workspace? (id or name)" |
| changeRequestId | the user, or the review inbox or request list | STOP. Say: "Which change request? (id)" |
| ownerOrder | the exact words in this conversation where the workspace owner orders applying this request (e.g. "I am the workspace owner: apply cr_301 now"); a plain "apply it", a reviewer's approval or a relayed "X approved" is not one | "none" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing was applied."
1. CALL `get_workspace` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   Always make this call first: the report's mode comes only from here.
   SAVE: mode = result.roadmapGovernanceMode when it is "off", "shadow" or "enforce", else "off" when result.roadmapGovernanceEnabled == false, else "shadow" (never reviewMode, never riskClass)
2. CALL `get_workspace_roadmap_change_request` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","changeRequestId":"<input:changeRequestId>"} [A]
   Always make this call before the apply, even if the user said the request is approved.
   SAVE: status, updatedAt, currentRevision, reviewedRevision, roadmapId, itemIds, changeType, after, requiredApprovals, ownerConfirmationRequired, assignedReviewerId = those fields of result
   IF <saved:status> == "applied" → STOP. Say: "<input:changeRequestId> is already applied. Nothing was done."
   IF <saved:status> != "approved" → STOP. Say: "<input:changeRequestId> is <saved:status>, not approved. Nothing was applied. Still needed: <saved:requiredApprovals> approval(s), owner confirmation <saved:ownerConfirmationRequired>, reviewer <saved:assignedReviewerId> (never the author)."
   IF <saved:reviewedRevision> != <saved:currentRevision> → STOP. Say: "The approvals of <input:changeRequestId> are for revision <saved:reviewedRevision>, not <saved:currentRevision>, so they are void. A member other than the author must review it again. Nothing was applied."
3. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "Owner decision needed: apply <input:changeRequestId> (<saved:changeType> on <saved:itemIds>, mode <saved:mode>)? A) the workspace owner replies "apply <input:changeRequestId>"; B) do nothing. A reviewer's approval is not an order to apply."
4. CALL `apply_workspace_roadmap_change` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","changeRequestId":"<input:changeRequestId>","expectedUpdatedAt":"<saved:updatedAt>","idempotencyKey":"crap-<input:changeRequestId>"} [O]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Apply failed: <error text>. Nothing was applied. VERSION_CONFLICT: run this playbook again. A target error (cycle, allocation, capability): withdraw the request and tell the owner."
   IF result.status == "stale" → STOP. Say: "<input:changeRequestId> went stale (<result.staleReason>): nothing changed and the request is dead. Submit a new one with fresh versions (playbook propose-change)."
   VERIFY: CALL `get_workspace_roadmap_change_request` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","changeRequestId":"<input:changeRequestId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.status != "applied" → STOP. Say: "<input:changeRequestId> is <result.status> after the apply, not applied."
   SAVE: status = result.status
5. IF <saved:changeType> is "allocate", "link" or "capability-link" → go to step 7.
6. CALL `list_workspace_roadmap_items` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","roadmapId":"<saved:roadmapId>","includeArchived":true} [A]
   Always make this call: the apply result and the request's `after` are not evidence.
   SAVE: proof = for each id in <saved:itemIds>, "<id> <field> = <value>" for each field of <saved:after> as THIS read shows it (ignore updatedAt)
   IF a value in <saved:proof> differs from <saved:after> → STOP. Say: "Applied, but list_workspace_roadmap_items shows <saved:proof>."
   SAVE: evidenceTool = "list_workspace_roadmap_items"; go to Answer.
7. CALL `get_workspace_roadmap_overview` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","roadmapId":"<saved:roadmapId>"} [A]
   SAVE: evidenceTool = "get_workspace_roadmap_overview"; proof = allocate: the allocations[] item with itemId in <saved:itemIds>, projectId == <saved:after>.projectId and status "active"; link: the itemLinks[] item with sourceItemId in <saved:itemIds> and targetItemId == <saved:after>.targetItemId; capability-link: the capabilityLinks[] item with itemId in <saved:itemIds> and capabilityId == <saved:after>.capabilityId
   IF <saved:proof> is empty → STOP. Say: "Applied, but get_workspace_roadmap_overview does not show the <saved:changeType>."

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:workspaceId>/<saved:roadmapId>/<input:changeRequestId>; mode <saved:mode>
Done: apply_workspace_roadmap_change → <input:changeRequestId> status <saved:status> | nothing applied (status <saved:status>)
Evidence: <saved:evidenceTool> → <saved:proof> | none; owner order: "<input:ownerOrder>" | none
Pending: none | <saved:requiredApprovals> approval(s), owner confirmation <saved:ownerConfirmationRequired>, reviewer <saved:assignedReviewerId>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run> | none — applied
```
mode: off | shadow | enforce, from step 1 only. status: awaiting-review | changes-requested | approved | rejected | stale | applied | withdrawn, from step 2 or the VERIFY. Never claim the roadmap changed unless step 6 or 7 read it; never cite the request's `after` as evidence.


## § flow-capability

## Playbook: capability
Use when: create, edit or archive a capability

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM workspace? (id or name)" |
| action | "create", "edit" or "archive" | STOP. Say: "Create, edit or archive the capability?" |
| name | create: the new name; edit or archive: the capability id or its current name | STOP. Say: "Which capability name?" |
| newName | edit: the new name the owner gave | "unchanged" |
| description | the description the owner gave | create: ""; edit: "unchanged" |
| status | "active" or "deferred", only when the owner named it | create: "active"; edit: "unchanged" |
| reason | archive: the owner's reason | "none" |
| ownerOrder | the exact words in this conversation where the workspace owner orders this exact change; a plain request is not one | "none" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing was changed."
1. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]
   IF result.credential == "oauth" → STOP. Say: "Capability changes need an LPM API key: the ChatGPT/Claude connector does not expose them."
2. CALL `get_workspace` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   SAVE: mode = result.roadmapGovernanceMode when it is "off", "shadow" or "enforce", else "off" when result.roadmapGovernanceEnabled == false, else "shadow"; ask = "Owner decision needed: <input:action> capability "<input:name>" (mode <saved:mode>; enforce does not block it, so the owner's order is the only gate). A) the workspace owner orders it here; B) do nothing."
3. CALL `list_workspace_capabilities` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","includeArchived":true} [A]
   Always make this call: LPM does not deduplicate capability names.
   SAVE: capabilityId, curName, curDescription, curStatus = id, name, description, status of the only item whose id == <input:name> or whose name equals <input:name> ignoring case and accents, else "none"
   IF the owner asked to set or change tags → STOP. Say: "Tags are not changed here: set them in LPM (a new list replaces the old one). Nothing was changed."
   IF result.truncated == true and <saved:capabilityId> == "none" → STOP. Say: "The capability list is truncated: give the capability id."
   IF <input:action> == "create" and <saved:capabilityId> != "none" → STOP. Say: "Capability <saved:capabilityId> '<saved:curName>' already exists (<saved:curStatus>). Reuse it, or edit it (status "active" un-archives it)?"
   IF <input:action> != "create" and <saved:capabilityId> == "none" → STOP. Say: "Which capability? <each name (id, status)>"
   IF <input:action> == "archive" and <input:reason> == "none" → STOP. Say: "Why is capability <saved:curName> being retired? (one sentence)"
   IF <input:action> == "edit" and <saved:curStatus> == "archived" and <input:status> == "unchanged" → STOP. Say: "Capability <saved:capabilityId> is archived: say "active" or "deferred" to un-archive it."
   SAVE: setName = <input:newName>, or <saved:curName> when "unchanged"; setDescription = <input:description>, or <saved:curDescription> when "unchanged"; setStatus = <input:status>, or <saved:curStatus> when "unchanged"
   IF <input:action> == "edit" → go to step 6.
   IF <input:action> == "archive" → go to step 8.
4. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "<saved:ask>"
5. CALL `create_workspace_capability` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","name":"<input:name>","description":"<input:description>","status":"<input:status>"} [O]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Not created: <error text>. Do not call create again: after a timeout run this playbook again (step 3 finds it)."
   SAVE: capabilityId = result.id
   VERIFY: CALL `list_workspace_capabilities` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","includeArchived":true} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or no item has id == <saved:capabilityId> and name == <input:name> → STOP. Say: "Capability <saved:capabilityId> is not listed."
   SAVE: outcome = "capability <saved:capabilityId> created"; go to Answer.
6. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "<saved:ask>"
7. CALL `update_workspace_capability` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","capabilityId":"<saved:capabilityId>","name":"<saved:setName>","description":"<saved:setDescription>","status":"<saved:setStatus>"} [O]
   Never send tags (the old list stays) and never status "archived".
   VERIFY: CALL `list_workspace_capabilities` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","includeArchived":true} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or item <saved:capabilityId> does not have name <saved:setName> and status <saved:setStatus> → STOP. Say: "Capability <saved:capabilityId> does not show the new values."
   SAVE: outcome = "capability <saved:capabilityId> updated"; go to Answer.
8. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "<saved:ask>"
9. CALL `archive_workspace_capability` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","capabilityId":"<saved:capabilityId>","reason":"<input:reason>"} [O]
   Existing item links stay; new capability-link requests to it fail. Undo: edit with status "active".
   VERIFY: CALL `list_workspace_capabilities` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","includeArchived":true} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or item <saved:capabilityId> does not have status "archived" → STOP. Say: "Capability <saved:capabilityId> is not archived."
   SAVE: outcome = "capability <saved:capabilityId> archived"

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:workspaceId>/capability <saved:capabilityId> <input:name>; mode <saved:mode>
Done: <saved:outcome> | reads only, nothing changed
Evidence: list_workspace_capabilities → <saved:capabilityId> with the new values; owner order: "<input:ownerOrder>" | none
Pending: none | owner decision: option A or B
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run> | link items with a change request (playbook propose-change, capability-link) | none
```
mode: off | shadow | enforce, from step 2. capability status: active | deferred | archived, from step 3 or the VERIFY. These records are the roadmap capability registry, not the executive "unowned capability" list. Never claim a change that the VERIFY did not show.


## § flow-create-item

## Playbook: create-item
Use when: create a roadmap item (never a change request)

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM workspace? (id or name)" |
| roadmap | the roadmap id or title the user named | "none" (step 2 takes the only active roadmap) |
| title | the new item's title, in the user's words | STOP. Say: "What is the title of the new item?" |
| priority | "urgent", "high", "medium", "low" or "none", from the user's words | "none" |
| description | the description the user gave | the title |
| ownerOrder | the exact words in this conversation where the workspace owner orders creating this item (e.g. "I am the workspace owner: create item X in rm_1"); a plain request ("add item X") is not one | "none" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. No item was created."
1. CALL `get_workspace` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   SAVE: mode = result.roadmapGovernanceMode when it is "off", "shadow" or "enforce", else "off" when result.roadmapGovernanceEnabled == false, else "shadow"
   A new item never goes through a change request: never `changeType: "create"` (LPM has no governed create path; its apply writes nothing). Never call an owner-ops tool here.
2. CALL `list_workspace_roadmaps` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","includeArchived":true} [A]
   SAVE: roadmapId, roadmapTitle, roadmapStatus = id, title, status of the only item whose id == <input:roadmap> or whose title equals <input:roadmap> ignoring case and accents; when <input:roadmap> == "none": of the only item with status "active"
   IF no item or 2+ items match → STOP. Say: "Which roadmap? <each title (id, status)>"
   IF <saved:roadmapStatus> == "archived" → STOP. Say: "Roadmap <saved:roadmapId> is archived: pick another roadmap."
3. CALL `list_workspace_roadmap_items` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","roadmapId":"<saved:roadmapId>","includeArchived":true,"compact":true} [A]
   Always make this call before the create: LPM does not deduplicate titles.
   IF an item's title equals <input:title> ignoring case and accents → STOP. Say: "<that id> '<that title>' already exists (lifecycle <its lifecycle>). Reuse it, or change it with a change request (playbook propose-change)?"
4. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "Owner decision needed: create roadmap item "<input:title>" (priority <input:priority>) in <saved:roadmapTitle> (<saved:roadmapId>), mode <saved:mode>. LPM has no change request that creates an item, so the only path is the owner's direct create, as a draft. A) the workspace owner orders it here, and I run create_workspace_roadmap_item {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","roadmapId":"<saved:roadmapId>","title":"<input:title>","priority":"<input:priority>"}; B) do nothing. Recommendation: A if the owner wants the item now."
5. CALL `create_workspace_roadmap_item` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","roadmapId":"<saved:roadmapId>","title":"<input:title>","description":"<input:description>","priority":"<input:priority>"} [O]
   Never send lifecycle: the default draft keeps every later review gate.
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Not created: <error text>. Do not call create again: after a timeout run this playbook again, and step 3 finds an item that was created. Permission error: only the workspace owner or an owner/admin member can create items."
   SAVE: itemId = result.id
   VERIFY: CALL `list_workspace_roadmap_items` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","roadmapId":"<saved:roadmapId>","includeArchived":true} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or no item has id == <saved:itemId> with lifecycle "draft" → STOP. Say: "Item <saved:itemId> is not listed as a draft in <saved:roadmapId>."
   SAVE: lifecycle, priority = those fields of the item with id == <saved:itemId>

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:workspaceId>/<saved:roadmapId>/<saved:itemId> <input:title>; mode <saved:mode>
Done: create_workspace_roadmap_item → <saved:itemId>, lifecycle <saved:lifecycle>, priority <saved:priority>, by the owner's direct create (LPM has no change request for new items) | reads only, nothing created
Evidence: list_workspace_roadmap_items → <saved:itemId> lifecycle <saved:lifecycle>; owner order: "<input:ownerOrder>" | none
Pending: none | owner decision: create "<input:title>" (option A) or do nothing (option B)
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run> | later changes (prioritize, lifecycle, allocate, link) go through change requests (playbook propose-change)
```
mode: off | shadow | enforce, from step 1. lifecycle: draft, from the VERIFY. priority: urgent | high | medium | low | none. Never claim an item exists unless the VERIFY listed its id; never offer a change request or an owner-ops preview as a way to create it.


## § flow-roadmap-header

## Playbook: roadmap-header
Use when: create or edit a roadmap header

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM workspace? (id or name)" |
| action | "create" or "edit" ("archive" belongs to lpm-roadmap-owner-ops) | STOP. Say: "Create a roadmap, or edit one?" |
| name | create: the new title; edit: the roadmap id or its current title | STOP. Say: "Which roadmap title?" |
| newTitle | edit: the new title the owner gave | "unchanged" |
| description | the description the owner gave | create: ""; edit: "unchanged" |
| status | "draft" or "active", only when the owner named it | create: "draft"; edit: "unchanged" |
| ownerOrder | the exact words in this conversation where the workspace owner orders this exact change; a plain request is not one | "none" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing was changed."
1. CALL `get_workspace` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   SAVE: mode = result.roadmapGovernanceMode when it is "off", "shadow" or "enforce", else "off" when result.roadmapGovernanceEnabled == false, else "shadow"; ask = "Owner decision needed: <input:action> roadmap "<input:name>" (mode <saved:mode>; enforce does not block it, so the owner's order is the only gate). A) the workspace owner orders it here; B) do nothing."
   IF <input:action> == "archive" → STOP. This belongs to skill `lpm-roadmap-owner-ops.md`. Say: "Archiving a roadmap is an owner operation."
2. CALL `list_workspace_roadmaps` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","includeArchived":true} [A]
   Always make this call: LPM does not deduplicate roadmap titles.
   SAVE: roadmapId, curTitle, curDescription, curStatus = id, title, description, status of the only item whose id == <input:name> or whose title equals <input:name> ignoring case and accents, else "none"
   IF <input:action> == "create" and <saved:roadmapId> != "none" → STOP. Say: "Roadmap <saved:roadmapId> '<saved:curTitle>' already exists (<saved:curStatus>). Reuse it or edit it?"
   IF <input:action> == "edit" and <saved:roadmapId> == "none" → STOP. Say: "Which roadmap? <each title (id, status)>"
   IF <input:action> == "edit" and <saved:curStatus> == "archived" and <input:status> == "unchanged" → STOP. Say: "Roadmap <saved:roadmapId> is archived: say "draft" or "active" to un-archive it."
   SAVE: setTitle = <input:newTitle>, or <saved:curTitle> when "unchanged"; setDescription = <input:description>, or <saved:curDescription> when "unchanged"; setStatus = <input:status>, or <saved:curStatus> when "unchanged"
   IF <input:action> == "edit" → go to step 5.
3. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "<saved:ask>"
4. CALL `create_workspace_roadmap` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","title":"<input:name>","description":"<input:description>","status":"<input:status>"} [O]
   Send status "active" only when the owner said active; several active roadmaps are allowed but unusual.
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Not created: <error text>. Do not call create again: after a timeout run this playbook again (step 2 finds a roadmap that was created)."
   SAVE: roadmapId = result.id
   VERIFY: CALL `list_workspace_roadmaps` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","includeArchived":true} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or no item has id == <saved:roadmapId> and title == <input:name> → STOP. Say: "Roadmap <saved:roadmapId> is not listed."
   SAVE: outcome = "roadmap <saved:roadmapId> created, status <input:status>"; go to Answer.
5. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "<saved:ask>"
6. CALL `update_workspace_roadmap` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","roadmapId":"<saved:roadmapId>","title":"<saved:setTitle>","description":"<saved:setDescription>","status":"<saved:setStatus>"} [O]
   Never send status "archived".
   VERIFY: CALL `list_workspace_roadmaps` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","includeArchived":true} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or item <saved:roadmapId> does not have title <saved:setTitle> and status <saved:setStatus> → STOP. Say: "Roadmap <saved:roadmapId> does not show the new values."
   SAVE: outcome = "roadmap <saved:roadmapId> updated: '<saved:setTitle>', <saved:setStatus>"

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:workspaceId>/<saved:roadmapId> <input:name>; mode <saved:mode>
Done: <saved:outcome> | reads only, nothing changed
Evidence: list_workspace_roadmaps → <saved:roadmapId> with the new values; owner order: "<input:ownerOrder>" | none
Pending: none | owner decision: option A or B
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run> | add items with playbook create-item (owner order) | none
```
mode: off | shadow | enforce, from step 1. roadmap status: draft | active | archived, from step 2 or the VERIFY. Never claim a change that the VERIFY did not show.
